# pwcli-core

> Open specification for intent-driven, dual-engine applications that combine a conversational/CLI surface with deterministic routes, schemas, registered panels, typed tools, provenance, and approval gates.

Use this file as the LLM-readable map for the repository. The core rule is
Standards Before Invention: prefer established open standards before creating
custom schemas.

## Core

- [README](README.md): Project overview and quick start.
- [Specification](SPEC.md): Complete architecture model, trust boundary, state machine, and output hierarchy.
- [Architecture engine prompt](prompts/architecture-engine.md): Canonical system prompt for design and implementation tasks.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): AI trust boundaries and security expectations.

## Schemas

- [Intent schema](schemas/intent.schema.json): Structured intent telemetry.
- [Primitive schema](schemas/primitive.schema.json): Registered UI primitive contract.
- [Route schema](schemas/route.schema.json): Static fallback route map.
- [Execution schema](schemas/execution.schema.json): Sandboxed execution metadata.
- [Source schema](schemas/source.schema.json): Source record, metadata, and provenance fields.
- [Provenance schema](schemas/provenance.schema.json): W3C PROV-O-aligned provenance record.
- [Rights schema](schemas/rights.schema.json): SPDX-compatible rights and license metadata.
- [Crosswalk schema](schemas/crosswalk.schema.json): Explicit standards translation mappings.
- [Context-pack schema](schemas/context-pack.schema.json): Markdown frontmatter convention.
- [Agent-card-lite schema](schemas/agent-card-lite.schema.json): Minimal A2A-inspired delegation profile.
- [Runtime adapter schema](schemas/runtime-adapter.schema.json): Metadata for wrapping existing agent runtimes with control-plane policy.
- [Redaction policy schema](schemas/redaction-policy.schema.json): Privacy, data-classification, and redaction policy metadata.

## Docs

- [Standards map](docs/standards-map.md): Maturity classification for standards and conventions.
- [Open data](docs/open-data.md): Harvest-first archive and dataset guidance.
- [Metadata crosswalks](docs/metadata-crosswalks.md): How to map records deterministically.
- [Agent interop](docs/agent-interop.md): MCP and A2A guidance.
- [Context packs](docs/context-packs.md): Markdown frontmatter operating context pattern.
- [Companion projects](docs/companion-projects.md): Related Protocol Wealth and maintainer open-source references.
- [Validation](docs/validation.md): Local and CI checks for schemas, crosswalks, context packs, links, metadata, and hygiene.
- [Human UX guide](docs/human-ux-guide.md): Progressive disclosure, approval friction, and primitive UX metadata.
- [Agent runtime adapters](docs/agent-runtime-adapters.md): How to leverage OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, MCP, A2A, Goose, Claude Code, and custom runtimes without reinventing them.
- [Privacy redaction control plane](docs/privacy-redaction-control-plane.md): Data classes, redaction stages, and policy boundaries for sensitive context.
- [Agent poisoning defense](docs/agent-poisoning-defense.md): Prompt injection, untrusted input, secret isolation, egress, and workflow poisoning controls.
